title: Orrery
description: A music box with no music in it. Bodies circle at whole-number ratios of one shared loop, each ringing a bell as it crosses the top — so the piece drifts out into dense polyrhythm and falls back into a single unison chord, forever. Nothing is composed; the seed picks the orbits, the scale and the key. Then drag to play it: up and down drives how fast the mechanism turns, left and right darkens or brightens the bells. Tap for a new sky.
